name: aioserver-vision-tool
description: Language model tool for attaching AIOServer screenshots as real image context during agent execution.

commands.title: AIOServer: Inspect Screenshot With Copilot Vision

chatParticipants.name: aioserver-vision
chatParticipants.description: Inspects AIOServer screenshots with real image input.

languageModelTools.name: aioserver-inspect-screenshot
languageModelTools.userDescription: Inspect an AIOServer screenshot or frame capture.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use this tool when you need to analyze an AIOServer screenshot or frame capture during visual testing. It reads the actual PNG or JPEG bytes, sends them to a vision-capable Copilot model as image input together with the question, and returns the model's analysis. Prefer this over reading screenshot files as text.

imagePath.description: Absolute path to the screenshot or frame image file.

question.description: What the model should determine from the screenshot.

context.description: Optional extra runtime context, expectations, or recent interaction history.
